description: Windows only (W5-5, §4 item 48): the document windows run without OS decorations (windows.rs) and the React title bar of the document webviews (`doc-*`, matched by webview label) drives the caption buttons of its own window through the window API (called without a window label, so Tauri uses the caller's current window, also after a tab moved): minimize, maximize/restore, close, and reading the maximized state for the button glyph.
